SELECT c.name,t.name AS tipo FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('inventar_SpcHidr.v_bitacora_rangos_norm') ORDER BY c.column_id

;WITH max_totalizador AS
        (
            SELECT MAX(fecha) AS Max_Fecha_Totalizador
            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.tot_TM
        ),
        rangos_dia AS
        (
            SELECT
                fecha_turno,
                MAX(ts_fin) AS Max_ts_fin_dia
            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_bitacora_rangos_norm
            WHERE fecha_turno >= :start
              AND fecha_turno <= :end
              AND Torre IN ('T1', 'T2', 'SRR')
            GROUP BY fecha_turno
        )
        SELECT MAX(r.fecha_turno) AS Fecha_Maxima_Exportable
        FROM rangos_dia r
        CROSS JOIN max_totalizador mt
        WHERE r.Max_ts_fin_dia <= mt.Max_Fecha_Totalizador;

SELECT * FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_bitacora_rangos_norm WHERE fecha_turno BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-10-31' AND Torre IN ('T1','T2','SRR')

SELECT CAST(fecha AS date) AS fecha,COUNT_BIG(*) AS registros,MIN(fecha) AS primer_ts,MAX(fecha) AS ultimo_ts FROM inventar_SpcHidr.tot_TM WHERE fecha >= '2026-09-28' AND fecha < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY CAST(fecha AS date) ORDER BY fecha

SELECT MAX(fecha_turno) AS max_fecha_rangos,MAX(CASE WHEN fecha_turno BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' THEN fecha_turno END) AS max_fecha_octubre FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_bitacora_rangos_norm WHERE Torre IN ('T1','T2','SRR')
